import pytest
from datetime import datetime
from service import validate_punch

def test_valid_punch():
    """Acceptance Criterion 1: valid punch within geofence and time window."""
    result = validate_punch(
        employee_id=123,
        timestamp=datetime(2023, 5, 1, 9, 30, 0),  # 09:30 local time
        lat=12.9717,
        lng=77.5945
    )
    assert result["valid"] is True
    assert result["reason"] == "Punch accepted"

import pytest
from datetime import datetime
from service import validate_punch

def test_invalid_location():
    """Acceptance Criterion 2: reject punch when outside 100 m radius."""
    # Coordinates ~200 m away from office location
    result = validate_punch(
        employee_id=124,
        timestamp=datetime(2023, 5, 1, 10, 0, 0),
        lat=12.9730,
        lng=77.5965
    )
    assert result["valid"] is False
    assert "outside" in result["reason"].lower()

import pytest
from datetime import datetime
from service import validate_punch

def test_invalid_time():
    """Acceptance Criterion 3: reject punch when timestamp is outside allowed window."""
    # Time before 06:00
    result = validate_punch(
        employee_id=125,
        timestamp=datetime(2023, 5, 1, 5, 45, 0),
        lat=12.9716,
        lng=77.5946
    )
    assert result["valid"] is False
    assert "outside" in result["reason"].lower() or "time" in result["reason"].lower()
